about.label: Introduction
about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm a Business Management Engineer focused on project management, business systems, and AI-driven automation. I work on building practical digital solutions that improve operations, decision-making, and customer experience across education, retail, and SaaS environments. My current work combines business strategy, process design, and technology implementation to create scalable systems that solve real-world problems. Based in Sonora, Mexico — building at the intersection of business management and modern technology.

highlights.strategic_desc: ISO-oriented process thinking combined with business strategy to design scalable, efficient systems.
highlights.ai_desc: Leverages AI automation, n8n workflows, and intelligent bots to streamline business operations.
highlights.systems_desc: Designs CRM/ERP implementations and SaaS product architectures with multi-tenant capabilities.
highlights.ops_desc: Data-driven optimization of business processes across education, retail, and SaaS environments.

services.title: What I do — engineered products at the seam of code, AI and operations.
services.saas_desc: End-to-end multi-tenant products on Next.js + Supabase: auth, RLS, schema, billing, dashboards.
services.ai_workflows_desc: Production agents and pipelines with Claude/OpenAI: scoring engines, RAG, structured output.
services.automation_desc: n8n + custom code to remove operational toil: invoice flows, reporting, internal tooling.
services.data_scraping_desc: Resilient Playwright scrapers with anti-detection, proxy rotation and structured outputs.
services.infra_desc: Self-hosted Proxmox, Docker, Cloudflare Tunnel and CI/CD pipelines for homelab-grade ops.
services.consulting_desc: Architecture audits, sprint planning and hands-on coaching for founders shipping their first SaaS.

experience.title: Where I've been building
experience.lec_desc: Founded and built the full ecosystem: marketing site, multi-tenant SaaS (lecorb), finance module and Playwright-automated data extraction. Operating across multiple schools in Mexico.
experience.csa_desc: E-commerce brand and operations: sprint roadmaps, frontend blueprint, and the full digital remediation plan from scratch.
experience.freelance_desc: 30+ products shipped for clients and personal ventures: AI workflows, scrapers, dashboards, automation, and trading research tools.
experience.education_desc: Systems-first engineering background. PMI Project Management certification track. Self-taught across the modern web, AI and DevOps stacks.

tier1.lastopp_desc: High-fidelity forensic command center for vehicle auction analysis. Deterministic scoring engine ranks lots by damage, production year, market bids, and historical patterns. Real-time telemetry dashboard, Telegram remote control, and Playwright-powered scraper nodes.
tier1.fixlab_desc: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for gadget repair shops. Kanban order flow from intake to delivery, precision inventory with SKU tracking, public customer-facing tracking portal, and Supabase-powered real-time updates.
tier1.oip_desc: Decision support system scanning prediction markets and crypto for spread/liquidity anomalies. Python analytical engines feed a Next.js 15 unified dashboard with the Aether Intelligence design system — glassmorphism over obsidian palettes.
tier1.designstudio_desc: Web platform for independent designers and front-end developers: WCAG contrast checker, palette extractor from images, and AI-powered strategic workshop using Claude. Deployed and live on Cloudflare Pages.
tier1.lec_desc: Full platform for LEC — a Cambridge English certification consultancy in Mexico. Marketing site (lec.mx), multi-tenant SaaS (lecorb), finance module, and Playwright-automated student data extraction from Cambridge centres.

tier2.cvos_desc: AI-powered CV parsing and job-matching pipeline built on n8n + Supabase. Extracts structured data from resumes and surfaces relevant opportunities automatically.
tier2.agents_desc: Multi-agent system ingesting YouTube channels, GitHub repos, and web pages into an Obsidian knowledge base. Built with Streamlit + Python with a digital chef and GitHub deep audit module.
tier2.n8n_desc: Internal automation backbone: document conversion workflows, Obsidian KB ingestion with pgvector, and job normalization pipelines. Runs self-hosted on Proxmox.
tier2.proxmox_desc: Self-hosted HP Z440 running Proxmox VE. Hosts n8n, Chatwoot, and all internal services via Cloudflare Tunnel. Full audit docs, hardening scripts, and ops runbooks.
tier2.csa_desc: Business digitization for a traditional commerce operation. Sprint roadmaps, frontend blueprint, branding, product labeling system, and a documented growth strategy for e-commerce expansion.
tier2.scraper_desc: Production-ready Playwright scraper with anti-detection, optional proxy rotation, and structured data output for Shopify stores. Modular architecture ready for scale.
